title: Armstrong Corset Lofts- 303-Downtown Arts District
description:
Parking is not included.  

This is a historic 3 floor building on the 5th Avenue of the Arts in downtown Nashville. In the early 1900s it was the Armstrong Corset Shop. Over the years we have renovated the 3rd floor & roof into 3 unique lofts.

The space
It's got a 17' spiral stair that we welded in place which leads to a private rooftop deck in the middle of downtown.  Stained concrete floors.  Exposed brick & 4 skylights.  Custom welded farm table & coffee table.  2 king-size beds.  Antique dressers, rug, buffet, chesterfield, & psychiatrist's couch.   Vintage porcelain barn & army lights.  A french press. A cocktail shaker.  A nespresso machine.  55" TV.

Guest access
Unit 303 it's all your's.

Other things to note
Your loft has a private rooftop deck that only you have access to.  It has hanging tea lights for a nice summertime ambience.

If you like this style, please check out our lofts in our other building 3 blocks away, the 1882 Lofts.
